controls.label: Field spread
controls.persistenceMeaning: Normalized distance of stable field zones from canvas centre.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes field endpoints and route control geometry while preserving route ID, edge start, cohort, and source order.
controls.causalTest: At field hold, 45 and 95 must change zone coordinates; all route IDs and identity order must match.

controls.label: Energy
controls.persistenceMeaning: Amplitude of deterministic local circulation and rotational response after arrival.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes field-exchange x/y/rotation offsets only; endpoints, route ownership, negative space, and seam remain fixed.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.49, 20 and 100 must differ geometrically while source order and zones remain equal.

controls.label: Negative space
controls.persistenceMeaning: Discrete authored exclusion anchor and amount used during field compilation.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes exclusion ellipse and pushes conflicting field centres outside it; source count and route ownership remain equal.
controls.causalTest: Each option must produce its declared ellipse and all field centres must remain at normalized distance ≥1.1.

controls.label: Route character
controls.persistenceMeaning: Cubic control geometry between the immutable owned edge start and field zone.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes intermediate route positions; start/end, route ID, cohort, field zone, and seam remain equal.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.12, arcs and hooks must differ; at t=0 and settled endpoint they must match.

controls.label: Focus lift
controls.persistenceMeaning: Maximum physical separation of the active print from its base field plane.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes active lift only; source pixels and non-active geometry are untouched.
controls.causalTest: At a focus peak, 70 must exceed 0 while all non-focused card states match.
